# Dex

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen_component_agents.py from xrds/dex.meta.yaml; edit the sidecar, not this file. -->

attach mode: a confidential OAuth2 client on an existing shared Dex server, for machine-to-machine client_credentials auth. server mode (no outputs below apply): the shared OIDC server itself.

## How it is requested

A `components[]` entry in an app's values file; the airframe-application chart renders the XR in the app's namespace. Wire it into the app with `env[].fromComponent` (never hand-write the derived names).

## Outputs

- `clientId`: Secret `{name}-oauth-credentials`, key `client-id`.
- `clientSecret`: Secret `{name}-oauth-credentials`, key `client-secret`.
- `issuer`: Secret `{name}-oauth-credentials`, key `issuer`.
- `tokenUrl`: Secret `{name}-oauth-credentials`, key `token-url`.
- `jwksUrl`: Secret `{name}-oauth-credentials`, key `jwks-url`.

## Where named objects come from

- Secret `{name}-oauth-credentials`: rendered by the composition function (when `spec.mode` is `attach`).
- Service `{name}`: rendered by the composition function (when `spec.mode` is `server`).

## Conditions

Besides Crossplane's Ready and Synced. Reasons are a closed set:

- `ComponentReady`: `DexAttachReady` (True), `DexAttachFailed` (False), `DexServerReady` (True), `DexServerProvisioning` (False).

## Verify a live XR

```
tools/airframe-verify dex <namespace>/<name> [--context CTX]
```

Read-only. Steps, after the implicit `xr-synced` check:

- `xr-ready` (condition): The Dex XR's ComponentReady condition has reason DexAttachReady (attach) or DexServerReady (server).
- `secret-exists` (secretKeys): Secret {name}-oauth-credentials exists in the app namespace with non-empty client-id and client-secret keys. Only when `spec.mode` is `attach`.
- `token-issuance` (oauthClientCredentials): POST {tokenUrl} with grant_type=client_credentials and the client-id/client-secret from the Secret returns a real access_token whose signing key is published at {jwksUrl} (reached through kubectl port-forward to the Dex server's Service). Only when `spec.mode` is `attach`.
- `server-discovery` (http): The Dex server's {name} Service answers GET /dex/.well-known/openid-configuration with 200 on 5556 (through kubectl port-forward). Only when `spec.mode` is `server`.

## Editing this composition

- Rendered by function-dex (Python, functions/function-dex), not go-templating. Build and push per its README; it has unit tests in CI.
- Attach mode adopts the secret the server already holds on already_exists and never prunes a live credentials Secret on a transient failure (review C1). It composes a Usage that blocks deleting the server while attachers exist.
